item.title: Five ways AI agents failed in production in 2026 — and the control that would have caught each
item.description: The incidents of 2026 were not model failures. They were missing controls, and almost none of them got a CVE. Here is the catalogue, mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications and to the test that finds each one before go-live.

item.title: The $50,000 hour: why agent cost needs a governor, not an alert
item.description: Every budget control sold today stops at the API key. The money is spent inside the agent loop, one retry, one escalation and one spawned sub-agent at a time — and the alert arrives a day later.
